hooks.command: command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f ~/.config/mise/conf.d/flow/tasks/flow/guard-commit ] || { echo '{"systemMessage": "The flow commit guards did not run: mise or its flow tasks are missing. Run /flow:sync."}'; exit 0; }; exec mise -C ~ run flow:guard-commit
command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f ~/.config/mise/conf.d/flow/tasks/flow/guard-neurons ] || exit 0; exec mise -C ~ run flow:guard-neurons
